Loot

  • Stuffed Bear

Speak with Dead

Vermit's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Goblin
      Vermit... True Soul...
  • What happened to you?
    • Goblin
      Saw Absolute... Ascended...
  • Who killed you?
    • Goblin
      Not killed... Ascended...
      • What do you mean 'ascended'?
        • Goblin
          Left flesh... joined with Her... eternally...
          • What happens to the bodies of those that 'ascend'?
            • Goblin
              Discarded... Devoured...
              • You're still brainwashed? Even now?
                • Narrator
                  *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
      • You didn't ascend, you just died.
        • Narrator
          *The corpse remains silent. That was more of a comment than a question, really.*
  • What is this place?
    • Goblin
      The Absolute's chamber... Paradise...
      • What happens here?
        • Goblin
          We meet Her... we ascend...
